name: language-codes
title: ISO Language Codes (639-1 and 639-2) and IETF Language Tags
description: Comprehensive language code information including ISO 639-1 (two-letter), ISO 639-2 (three-letter bibliographic and terminologic) codes, and IETF language tags from the Unicode CLDR.

sources.name: Library of Congress
sources.title: Library of Congress ISO 639-2 Registration Authority

licenses.name: ODC-PDDL-1.0
licenses.title: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License v1.0. Covers only the maintainers' own selection and formatting. The terms of the Library of Congress ISO 639-2 list (the three language-codes files) are unclear.

resources.name: language-codes
resources.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes and their English names.

resources.name: language-codes-3b2
resources.description: Languages with both ISO 639-2 bibliographic (three-letter) and ISO 639-1 (two-letter) codes, limited to the languages that have an alpha-2 code.

resources.name: language-codes-full
resources.description: All ISO 639-2 languages with bibliographic and terminologic three-letter codes, optional two-letter alpha-2 code, and English and French names.

resources.name: ietf-language-tags
resources.description: One row per locale file in the Unicode CLDR core data (not every valid IETF language tag), derived from the Unicode CLDR core.zip (common/main folder of https://www.unicode.org/Public/cldr/latest/core.zip), with language type, territory, revision date, definition count, and default-language flag.

fields.name: langType
fields.description: language code (2 or 3 letters, plus the value root)

fields.name: territory
fields.description: ISO3166-1-Alpha-2 country code or cldr territory code where 001 is the World and 150 is Europe

fields.name: revGenDate
fields.description: Revision date of the CLDR locale file (YYYY-MM-DD); empty when not specified in the source XML. Currently always empty.

fields.name: dftLang
fields.description: 1 if CLDR lists this locale as the default content of its language (for example af-ZA), 0 otherwise. A few entries in CLDR's list have no locale file in the core download, so they have no row.
